company.name: Axonius
company.shortDescription: Axonius is an asset inventory management platform that focuses on cybersecurity solutions and policies.
company.description:
Axonius is a cybersecurity asset management platform that provides asset inventory, uncovers security solution coverage gaps, and validates and enforces security policies.

It delivers a unified, extensible, and open system that integrates information from networked devices and existing device-specific standalone management service, creating a single visibility and control environment, enabling Information technology and security operations teams to safely engage device adoption and usage at scale.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based asset intelligence platform that aggregates and correlates data from security and IT systems to provide a unified inventory of technology assets, identities, exposures, and controls.
productsAndServices.name: Axonius Asset Cloud

productsAndServices.description: A solution for identifying and classifying hardware, software, cloud resources, identities, and other technology assets across an organization’s environment.
productsAndServices.name: IT Asset Discovery

productsAndServices.description: A solution that correlates asset inventory, vulnerabilities, security-control coverage, misconfigurations, ownership, and business context to prioritize and remediate exposures.
productsAndServices.name: Exposure Management

productsAndServices.description: A solution for checking whether endpoints meet required security, configuration, and management policies and for identifying gaps that require remediation.
productsAndServices.name: Endpoint Compliance Verification

productsAndServices.description: A solution that reconciles asset data from multiple systems to improve the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and currency of configuration-management databases.
productsAndServices.name: CMDB Data Quality Improvement

productsAndServices.description: A solution that provides consolidated asset and identity context to help security teams investigate incidents, scope affected systems, and coordinate remediation.
productsAndServices.name: Cyber Incident Response
